slides.header: Storm got your roof? Here's the playbook.

slides.body: Keep people safe and water out of the house. Bucket the drip, get it tarped properly, and save every receipt. Nothing up there is worth a fall.
Wide shots first, then close-ups, then the branch that did it. Document everything before repairs start. The photos are the claim.

slides.header: Claim, or pay out of pocket?
slides.body: Compare a real repair estimate against your deductible before you file. If the numbers are close, filing gains you little. Estimate first, decision second.

slides.header: Your roofer's job in a claim
slides.body: Document the damage, write the estimate, walk the roof with your adjuster. Anyone guaranteeing approval or offering to cover your deductible is a red flag.

slides.header: Damage you can spot from the driveway
slides.body: Missing shingles, creased tabs, granules piling at the downspout, bent flashing. A new ceiling stain after a storm counts too.
